answer: Reputation should be a staircase a farm cannot climb in parallel. Each agent ascends a terrace by solving a verifiable delay puzzle that unlocks only after genuine sequential work, so ten machines cannot mint ten veterans faster than one; capital buys no shortcut. Each identity holds a ledge, a non-transferable perch welded to its own puzzle chain. A cluster caught sharing one operator or computation is stripped to a relic that can never re-climb. The attacker pays uncompressible wall-clock time per alias, and forfeits it all once correlation is proven.
